evidence.title: Memory module — decay overview
evidence.content: The default uniform decay rate is 10 percent per month. The decay applies during prune sweeps. Memories whose confidence falls below the 0.2 prune floor are dropped.

evidence.title: Per-mode memory rule overrides
evidence.content: Modes can override the default decay rate via their TOML manifest's memory_rules block. Three retired research-shaped skills declared 0.05 per month; those values were not promoted to defaults.
